title: Claude Code Hooks Configuration
description: Schema for a Claude Code hooks configuration (plugin hooks/hooks.json or the `hooks` block in settings.json). Anthropic does not publish a standalone machine-readable schema, so this is derived from the Claude Code hooks reference (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks — Configuration, Hook Events) as of 2026-07-09, cross-checked against the plugin hooks files Claude Code loads. Event names are enumerated from the documented list; a Claude Code release adding new events requires re-vendoring.

description.description: Human-readable summary of what the hook set does. Accepted in plugin hooks.json files.

hooks.description: Map of hook event name to an array of matcher groups.

matcherGroup.description: One matcher group: an optional matcher pattern plus the hook commands that run when it matches.

matcher.description: Filter pattern; matched value depends on the event (tool name regex for PreToolUse/PostToolUse/PostToolUseFailure, compaction trigger for PreCompact, source for SessionStart). Omitted or empty matches everything.

commandHook.description: Command hook: executes a shell command that receives the event JSON on stdin.

type.description: Hook execution type; only "command" is documented.

command.description: Executable or shell command. Plugin hooks may reference ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} or a binary placeholder substituted at install time.

args.description: Arguments passed to the command (plugin hooks form).
